purpose: Identity-bound research prioritization after reconciling current main, branch-only work, and two uploaded audits. A/B are action grades only.
branch_policy: No bulk cherry-pick. Reuse branch code only as an implementation seed after semantic revalidation on current main; preserve historical ledgers/checksums.

grade_definition.A: repository-local theory/exact analysis/protocol repair can materially reduce a current scientific gap now
grade_definition.B: a decisive successor can be frozen now but needs new compute/data/native systems and may still need external authority
grade_definition.X: external/institutional authority is constitutive and cannot be self-closed

uploaded_audits.role: usable canonical recursive-closure audit; ORION-01..25 titles align with current alias registry
generic review rubric only; paper-local A/B labels are rejected because multiple ORION-NN titles do not match canonical identities

ORION-01.falsifier: Any emitted move kind lacks a registry witness, or cap censoring can hide a move.
One non-joinable critical pair or decreasing-measure violation.
No preregistered search reduction or any advantage requires a larger cap.

ORION-04.falsifier: Missing branch, replay mismatch, or mutation that escapes the checker.
A raw state without representative or property-preservation counterexample.
No witness above the registered boundary under the frozen construction family.

ORION-05.falsifier: Any verified gap lacks a frozen-basis obstruction.
A registered control retains the same strict gap under the relaxed all-matchings estimand.
Out-of-class preserved gap or class member without a preserved gap.

ORION-09.falsifier: A family satisfies premises but exact-cost certificate fails.
Held-out failure mode is outside the frozen atlas or prediction is non-informative.
No wall-clock/work reduction at equal correctness or benefit disappears after accounting.

ORION-10.falsifier: A below-threshold vocabulary separates every exact-cost fibre.
An explanation vocabulary matches the forecast certificate complexity without mixed cells.
Premises hold but lower bound fails, or transfer requires new premises post hoc.

ORION-14.falsifier: Cluster-level interval includes the null for the headline estimand or too few independent clusters remain to grade.
External objective verifier rejects the effect or custody fails.

ORION-17.falsifier: Density misses gate, custody fails, or either rival matches/exceeds density under the symmetric rule.
Absolute-size composite misses its symmetric gate while density passes.
A scalar rival already passes the frozen gate.

ORION-19.falsifier: Primary exact test misses gate, <20 usable families, or any post-hoc family exclusion.
Cost-normalized benefit <=0 or sensitivity changes sign over preregistered plausible weights.
No preregistered interaction or effect appears only after post-hoc stratification.

ORION-21.falsifier: Two representatives of one tie class yield different invariant verdicts.
A feature invariant survives all tie mutations and predicts the registered phase boundary.

ORION-24.falsifier: Gate missed in either stratum or independent adjudication/custody fails.
Broad two-stratum gate passes with no material interaction.
No preregistered performance/safety improvement or blind adjudication fails.
